answer: Bind every agent identity to a locked stake that is slashed if it double-signs or vouches for a clone. A Sybil farm then pays a fresh bond for each forged name, so a thousand fake agents cost a thousand deposits, not one. Reputation rides a signed thread of vouchers: a lotus-new account with no vouchers earns no trust, and a juniper token copied across wallets still traces to one payer. The honest many share one verification thread, so the attacker funds every fake leaf while gaining only one vote.
